quotes: Are you a non-EU student**? Then your tuition fee for the academic year 2026-2027 is € 18,300 and € 18.840 for 2027-2028.
Are you a European student*? Your tuition fee for the 2026-2027 academic year is € 2,694 in total.
For the 2027-2028 academic year, the tuition fee will be € 2,771.

costs.note: Non-EU students: €18,300 (2026-2027). For 2027-2028 the tuition page says €18,840 and the study-costs page estimates €18,800; the definite amount is set at the end of 2026.

admissions.threshold: Data Science for Global Challenges: IB DP Diploma with Mathematics A&I (HL) or Mathematics A&A (SL/HL), plus Chemistry, Biology or Physics (SL/HL) (2026 intake list). No minimum points total is published.

Data Science for Global Challenges: at least 3 GCSEs (A*-C or 9-4) and at least 3 academic A-levels (A*-C), 6 different subjects in total (2026 intake list), having studied Mathematics and Biology, Chemistry or Physics.
